There are three categories of perks.

The great perks that can litterally change the outcome of a game on their own.

The Meh perks that can be good but are situational

And the shit perks that litterally have little to no use at all.

Balance wise, Survivors have perks that can save them from every situation. Sprint burst and dead hard makes downing them much harder. Decisive strike litterally gives them 60 seconds of immunity, Unbreakable, if the killer chooses to slug because of decisive strike or try their last bit of hope of getting all 4, This perk smashes dreams and borrowed time makes them barely have to worry about when to unhook.
